about_the_game:
Please note the following limitations in this demo version:

- Gameplay is limited by a time constraint. Once the timer runs out, you can start a new cycle and select a different theme from the main menu.

- The demo includes 6 of the 12 original levels.

- The ability to create custom themes is not available.

- High scores are not uploaded to the online leaderboard.
